title: Roller coaster · archive operation
source_selection: One continuous upward tilt follows the lift hill, crest tower and climbing train. The source is a wooden lattice, while the native doodle is sparse hill/rail strokes. Static scene geometry moves because of camera tilt; train is a separately credited source-observed prop.
review_note: Fresh blind still review passed native identity and sampled source framing/pose. Final same-instance mask fit, classifier and normal-speed playback remain unrun; zero verified planted intervals fails the contact gate. No training ran.

observation_time_note.method: Estimated local pixel appearance correspondence between frozen SAM JPEGs and retained raw frames; grayscale96x72RMSE<=2 andrunnerupgap>=.25. Ambiguous samples use clock interpolation between accepted anchors, or nominal12fps extrapolation at ends.

continuous_source.evidence: Sixteen raw-source samples visually inspected in preflight/source-design-sheet.jpg; final source-contact-sheet.jpg additionally spans refined clock interval. No cut/dissolve in selected event.

compatibility.mask_fit_status: not measured for this integrated geometry; no segmentation confidence used as fit

assembly_summary: The nineteen native rail/support strokes follow the camera tilt up the lift hill; separately credited train and crest-tower observations keep the climb visible. Source lattice detail remains deliberately sparse.
bounded_repair_v2: V1 independent critic: absent right-hand banked-track structure and unsupported sky contour. Native19hillstrokes, ties, supports, tower and train untouched.
